scope: Sanitized behavior-affecting configuration for the current Linux reference instance; no patients, notes, transcripts, chat, vocabulary values, backup paths, secrets, or export content.

writingModel.selection: Linux intentionally falls back to SMALL_MODEL because machineMemoryGib is macOS-only; the live database has no llm_model override. Recovery pins the same tag explicitly so another OS or RAM size cannot select a different tier.

observedLaunch.serviceManager: systemd system unit ollama.service (Arch packages ollama + ollama-rocm 0.33.3-1) with a drop-in at /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/override.conf

speech.observedBackend: Vulkan (RADV, RX 9070 XT). whisper-cli is built from source at whisper.cpp commit 371b5a7561823ab2bb32142d2751e35e7534727b by scripts/v2/package-linux-resources.sh and bundled in the AppImage; for browser mode and verify it is put on PATH as a symlink to build/linux-resources/bin/whisper-cli (RUNPATH $ORIGIN finds its libraries).

noteFormats.note: Owner's revised 2026-09-24 progress instructions (Q4 fuller-sentence Intervention). This is the sanitized instruction text actually stored in the live format. Keep the live snapshot and this hash in sync after any owner-approved instruction change.

acquisition.writingModelCaveat: The existing installer pulls an Ollama tag and checks presence, but Ollama does not expose the pinned registry manifest through the installer contract. Verify ollamaListId and weightsBlobSha256 after acquisition; refuse a mismatch rather than claiming byte-identical recovery.
acquisition.runtimeCaveat: Observed Linux executable hashes identify this machine, but the repository does not redistribute those executables. Reinstalling the named runtime versions may produce different binary hashes or unavailable historical builds.
